coordination_protocol.purpose: process fix for bottleneck 7 — two coder lines share one operator key pool; without a shared reservation surface each seal consumes the other's headroom blind (the R498 incident, twice-recorded)
rules: 1. RESERVE-BEFORE-SPEND: any round intending metered debits appends a RESERVATION row {round, line, purpose, max_debits, bucket_id} to this ledger BEFORE its first metered call; the reservation is a budget intent, not a measured spend

2. MEASURE-METER-FIRST: the standing R498 stewardship guard — re-measure the provider meter before the first call of every spend; a meter below (max_debits + floor) types POOL_EXHAUSTED_MEASURED and the spend does not start

3. RECONCILE-AFTER-SPEND: append an OUTCOME row {debits, meter_before, meter_after, purpose} — unexplained deltas type CROSS_LINE_UNEXPECTED_DEBIT and freeze further spend on that bucket pending owner input (never re-rolled, never absorbed silently)
4. FLOOR-IS-LAW: no spend may cross reserve floor 2; seal-scale work (6 debits) on a key below floor+6 requires the next rotated operator key

5. RESERVATIONS EXPIRE: a reservation row not reconciled by an OUTCOME row within the same round is marked EXPIRED_UNSPENT by the next round's intake (anti-entropy: the ledger never accumulates phantom headroom)
coordination_protocol.enforcement: records-level (this ledger is the coordination surface); CI/pin-level enforcement is post-harvest work, not unilaterally built now (scope law: observer-side records only until harvest)
